", "emphasis_spans": 1}, {"id": "ru77-u032-r0002", "tag": "p", "text": "“Sire, as between clothes and countenance, you are all right, there is no discrepancy; but as between your clothes and your bearing, you are all wrong, there is a most noticeable discrepancy.
